definitions.gloss: to look after; to take care of; to attend to
definitions.explanation: To provide care, supervision, or assistance to someone. Often used for caring for children, elderly family members, or subordinates.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}している→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: While my mother was in the hospital, my father took care of the housework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}て⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The senior staff always look after the new employees, so the workplace atmosphere is good.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common expression meaning to care for or look after someone or something. The verb ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ conjugates normally as an ichidan verb. Often used with particles like ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ before ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る (to look after children)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る (to look after one's parents)
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る (to look after junior colleagues)
- {面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}て⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to be looked after)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take care of — slightly more formal, can also mean to arrange or mediate
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to provide nursing care — specifically for elderly or disabled persons
